title: Anchored pricing experiment: auto-SQ decisioning + retention bands for observability add-on
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description:
Objective: run a controlled experiment to evaluate an anchored (reference-priced) add-on for observability retention and a bundled 'Compliance Pack' that automates portions of the security questionnaire (SQ) to speed enterprise procurement. Hypothesis: (1) a clear price anchor for retention tiers + an automated SQ summary will increase conversion on enterprise quotes by 12% and reduce sales cycle time by ~10 days; (2) per-customer retention bands enforced by entitlements will reduce over-provision billing disputes and lower cost leakage by 6%.

Scope: MVP covers: (A) three retention bands (30d, 90d, 365d) as an observability add-on with SKU-based pricing and an optional Compliance Pack (legal template + auto-SQ preflight). (B) Console purchase flow UI + backend entitlement issuance. (C) Contract workflow integration: when Compliance Pack is selected, generate prefilled SQ responses to attach to the quote; flag deals requiring legal review.

Success metrics (primary):
- Enterprise quote-to-sign conversion lift +12% (cohort: inbound trials with >$10k TCV).
- Median sales cycle reduction >=10 days for deals that used auto-SQ.
- Reduce retention-related billing disputes by 6% within 60d of rollout.
Secondary metrics:
- Add-on attach rate for mid-market accounts (+3 p.p.).
- Time-to-enable (entitlement issuance) median < 2 hours.

Experiment design: A/B test at quote-level (Sales workflow):
- Control: salesperson issues quote with manual SQ + default retention options.
- Variant A: anchored pricing shown (MSRP + discounted enterprise price) + Compliance Pack checkbox that triggers automated SQ prefill.
- Variant B: variant A + immediate entitlement issuance on quote acceptance (no post-contract provisioning delay).

Rollout & instrumentation:
- Duration: 8 weeks pilot, geo-limited to NA region.
- Target sample: 120 qualified enterprise trials (expected N).
- Telemetry: dashboard capturing quote creation, Compliance Pack checkbox usage, SQ automation success rate, entitlement issue latencies; experiment dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/experiments/PM-68421
- GitHub PRs: platform automation + entitlement service: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/14821
- Console UI mockups and copy: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-Observability-Addons-MVP

Acceptance criteria for GA:
- Statistically significant conversion lift (p<0.1) or clear operational improvements (sales cycle reduction OR provisioning time).
- Legal signs off on auto-SQ templates and failure modes documented.
- Entitlement system throughput validated for daily peak of pilot (5k entitlements/day).

Trade-offs and open questions: 
- Risk: automating parts of the SQ could produce inaccurate answers if customers modify contract wording; mitigation: require salesperson confirmation before finalizing prefilled SQ.
- Pricing: anchored MSRP may anchor negotiations downward; mitigations: use regional MSRP and time-limited discounting.
- Entitlement complexity: immediate issuance (Variant B) increases provisioning risk; add conservative circuit-breaker and rollback hooks.

Implementation notes / milestones:
- Week 0–1: finalize SQ templates with Legal and Security (owner: Legal - Priya Kaur).
- Week 1–2: console UI + copy implementation (owner: UX - Daniel Park).
- Week 2–4: entitlement API + automation (owner: ENG - Ravi Patel) + QA.
- Week 4–6: pilot enablement with Sales pilot cohort (owner: RevOps - Liam Chen).
- Week 6–8: analyze results, decision gate for broader rollout.

Communication plan: kickoff sync w/ Sales, Legal, Security, Engineering on 2025-02-18 (notes: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/PM-68421-kickoff). Weekly status updates in #pm-addons Slack channel.
